summary:
EARTHTRACE is an AI-powered web application that transforms environmental data into an interactive detective experience. Using NASA GLDAS data obtained through Giovanni, it helps users investigate changes in rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture, with an initial focus on Sri Lanka.

Users choose locations, variables, and time periods, then explore evidence through interactive maps, time-series graphs, location comparisons, and anomaly detection. The application calculates rates of change and uses the Mann–Kendall test to assess statistical significance. An integrated AI Earth Detective explains findings, answers questions in Sinhala or English, and helps users understand relationships, uncertainty, and data limitations.

EARTHTRACE addresses the “Earth System Trend Detective” challenge by combining data exploration, visualization, statistical analysis, and AI-assisted interpretation in one accessible platform. Its investigation-based approach encourages users to ask questions and draw conclusions grounded in evidence.

By making Earth science more understandable and engaging, EARTHTRACE empowers students and communities to explore environmental change and develop the knowledge needed for informed discussions about our planet’s future.
details:
Project TerraLume - EARTHTRACE

Problem Statement

Environmental changes such as rising temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, and variations in soil moisture are difficult to understand and analyze. Although NASA provides valuable Earth science data, its complexity makes it challenging for students and the general public to identify environmental trends and understand their significance.

Proposed Solution

EARTHTRACE – Earth Mystery Investigation System is an AI-powered platform that transforms complex NASA Earth science data into an interactive detective-style experience. Using NASA GLDAS data, statistical analysis, interactive maps, and visualizations, users can investigate environmental trends across Sri Lanka. A bilingual AI Earth Detective helps explain scientific findings in Sinhala and English, making environmental exploration simple, engaging, and accessible.

What does it do, and how does it work?

Users begin by selecting an environmental mystery, such as rising heat or missing rain. They choose a district, environmental variables, and a time period, then investigate the evidence through graphs, maps, and comparisons.

The platform uses NASA GLDAS data obtained through Giovanni. It processes monthly observations into annual rainfall totals and day-weighted annual averages for temperature and soil moisture. Only complete calendar years are included, and at least five complete years are required for trend testing.

EARTHTRACE calculates linear rates of change, estimates Sen’s slope, and applies the Mann–Kendall test to assess statistical significance. Users can compare two locations, explore multiple variables using standardized charts, compare individual years, and identify unusual annual values through anomaly detection.

The AI Earth Detective explains findings in Sinhala or English, answers questions about the evidence, and helps users understand statistical terms and uncertainty. Its role is to interpret supplied analysis results rather than invent observations or replace statistical calculations. Users can also save investigations, revisit their history, and export reports through the browser’s PDF printing feature.

Benefits and intended impact

Earth science datasets can be difficult to interpret without specialist knowledge. EARTHTRACE brings data exploration and basic statistical analysis into a guided workflow that students, educators, and interested members of the public can understand.

The intended impact is to strengthen environmental literacy and evidence-based reasoning. Users are encouraged to investigate where changes occur, measure their magnitude, and consider whether the available evidence supports a trend. Sinhala and English explanations make the experience more accessible to local audiences.

The platform supports learning and exploration; it is not a weather forecasting system or a substitute for validated scientific assessments.

Tools and technologies

The frontend uses Next.js, React, and TypeScript, with CSS for responsive layouts and animations. Recharts supports charts, while D3-geo and a canvas-based globe support geographic exploration. Simplified Sri Lankan district boundaries are provided through geoBoundaries.

Python and FastAPI support backend services and statistical analysis. Firebase Authentication manages user access, and Cloud Firestore stores saved investigations. The AI service uses Google ADK and Gemini, with SQLite-backed conversation sessions. Development was carried out using Visual Studio Code and standard computers; no specialist hardware is required.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/chathunisuhansa2003/NASA_EARTHTRACE.git

What makes the project creative?

EARTHTRACE turns data exploration into a sequence of mysteries, clues, observations, and findings. Users record what they notice before viewing the statistical interpretation, encouraging active investigation rather than passive chart viewing.

The rotating Earth, environmental maps, comparison tools, and detective-themed interface connect scientific analysis with an engaging learning experience. The AI assistant adds conversational guidance while keeping the numerical evidence visible.

Factors considered by the team

We considered usability, language accessibility, mobile responsiveness, privacy, data coverage, and scientific transparency. Missing observations are not fabricated, incomplete years are excluded, and demonstration results are distinguished from real analysis.

We also communicate important limitations: correlation does not establish causation, statistical significance depends on test assumptions, and the current analysis does not adjust for serial correlation or multiple testing. District-labelled climate series are displayed on administrative maps with a clear notice that their original sampling footprints require further verification.

These choices help users explore environmental change while understanding both the value and the limits of the evidence.

FRONTEND EXPERIENCE: EXPLORING EARTH THROUGH INTERACTIVE INVESTIGATIONS

EARTHTRACE provides a visually engaging, detective-themed interface designed to make environmental investigation accessible and intuitive.

The experience combines an animated Earth globe, interactive Sri Lankan district maps, environmental dashboards, and responsive data visualizations. Users can move between investigation missions, explore selected variables, examine historical patterns, and compare findings across locations.

Rather than relying on static charts, the platform supports interactive exploration through time-series graphs, comparative visualizations, anomaly detection, and individual-year analysis. These features enable users to investigate environmental changes from multiple perspectives.

The interface is designed around a consistent blue-and-green environmental theme, with carefully selected animations and visual transitions that enhance engagement without distracting from the scientific evidence.

BACKEND: FROM NASA DATA TO SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE

Behind the interactive experience, EARTHTRACE uses a structured data-processing and statistical-analysis workflow.

Environmental datasets obtained from NASA GLDAS through Giovanni are processed to support consistent annual analysis. The system validates temporal coverage, excludes incomplete calendar years, and handles missing observations without fabricating measurements.

Rainfall is represented through annual accumulated totals, while temperature and soil moisture are summarized using day-weighted annual averages. Trend analysis is performed using linear regression, Sen's slope estimation, and the Mann–Kendall test, supported by anomaly identification and comparisons across locations and variables.

Python and FastAPI support the processing and analytical services, while the frontend presents the resulting evidence through interactive charts and maps.

An AI-assisted explanation layer, developed using Google ADK and Gemini, helps interpret statistical findings using supplied analysis results. Firebase services support user authentication and saved investigations, while SQLite supports AI conversation sessions.

This separation between numerical computation, visualization, and AI explanation promotes transparency and reduces the risk of unsupported scientific interpretations.

Creativity – Turning Environmental Data Into an Earth Detective Experience

EARTHTRACE transforms traditional environmental data analysis into an interactive and engaging Earth Detective Experience. Instead of simply presenting scientific data through graphs and numbers, our platform encourages users to explore environmental mysteries, investigate evidence, and discover meaningful changes in Earth's environmental systems.

Our creativity focuses on combining detective-style storytelling, interactive visualizations, scientific analysis, and artificial intelligence to make environmental exploration more engaging, educational, and accessible.

1. Mystery-Based Exploration

EARTHTRACE introduces a unique investigation-based approach where users become Earth Detectives. Instead of starting with complex datasets, users begin by selecting environmental mysteries such as rising temperatures, changing rainfall patterns, or decreasing soil moisture.

Each mystery guides users through selecting locations, environmental variables, and time periods, transforming traditional data analysis into an exciting detective journey.

2. Observe Before Concluding

One of our most innovative features encourages users to think like real scientists.

Before viewing the final statistical interpretation, users are encouraged to examine environmental graphs, identify patterns, and record their own observations.

They can then compare their initial findings with statistical analysis results. This approach promotes critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and evidence-based reasoning rather than passive data consumption.

3. Interactive Earth Exploration

EARTHTRACE combines an animated rotating Earth globe, interactive Sri Lankan district maps, and visually engaging environmental dashboards to create an immersive exploration experience.

Users can explore geographic locations, investigate environmental variables, and visualize how conditions change across different regions and time periods.

The platform uses a modern blue-and-green environmental theme, smooth animations, and interactive visual elements to make scientific exploration both attractive and intuitive.

4. Multi-Dimensional Environmental Evidence

Unlike traditional environmental dashboards that focus on individual datasets, EARTHTRACE allows users to investigate environmental changes from multiple perspectives.

Users can compare different years, environmental variables, and geographical locations to identify patterns and differences in rainfall, temperature, and soil moisture.

Interactive time-series graphs, comparison charts, and anomaly detection help users recognize unusual environmental conditions and investigate long-term trends.

This multi-dimensional approach encourages users to explore relationships between environmental variables while understanding that correlation does not necessarily establish causation.

5. Bilingual AI Scientific Guide

A key creative feature of EARTHTRACE is the AI Earth Detective, an intelligent assistant developed using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Gemini.

The assistant supports conversations in Sinhala and English, allowing users to ask questions about environmental trends, statistical findings, and scientific uncertainty in their preferred language.

Instead of generating unsupported scientific conclusions, the AI assistant focuses on explaining supplied analysis results in simple, understandable language.

This feature makes complex Earth science information more accessible to Sri Lankan students, educators, researchers, and the general public.

Our Creative Vision

Through the combination of mystery-based exploration, interactive Earth visualizations, scientific evidence, and bilingual AI assistance, EARTHTRACE creates a unique learning experience that connects technology, environmental science, and human curiosity.

Our goal is to transform users from passive viewers of environmental data into active investigators who question, explore, analyze, and understand the evidence behind Earth's changing environment.

EARTHTRACE is more than an environmental data visualization platform. It is an interactive journey of scientific discovery, where every observation becomes a clue and every investigation brings us closer to understanding our planet.

Every Change Leaves a Clue. Discover What Earth Is Telling Us.
